flags: Partial overview: both NCDOT cache files contain identical truncated guidebook bodies ending near Flat Rock, before the Grassy Island entry. Only the contents and map index identify this as a Piedmont scenic byway. No route-specific designation rationale, road-building history, driving character, drive time or end-to-end sequence is available. Intro is intentionally short and its final paragraph gives geographic anchors, not verified navigation.

Dropped unsupported current claims: US 52 start north of Ansonville; Pinkston River Road and both Grassy Island Road segments; NC 109 crossing; twelve-mile continuation to Holly Grove Church Road near Ellerbe; rise toward the Uwharries; Grassy Island name and earthen-island explanation. Regional habitat is supported only at the refuge, not as a roadside description.
Retained all three existing moments and coordinates. Order follows Ansonville’s early strip position, then river excursions; cache does not establish their exact byway access points.
Ansonville and Blewett Falls moments are under 90 words because further relevant evidence is limited. College closure dates disagree; no surviving college building or visitor access is claimed.
Refuge access is not verified by a manager page. No visiting arrangements or guaranteed bird sightings are given.
Current stories have no story or moment motifs; empty arrays supplied.
Guidebook extraction includes unrelated routes and interleaved columns. No descriptions of those other routes were borrowed for Grassy Island.
